open_points.subject: context
open_points.text: “An image left by a failed record write is completed by a repeated delivery of the same file.” contradicts “a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement, unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.”
open_points.question: When an image remains without a placement and A6 rule 5 applies on the repeated delivery, must that delivery complete the placement or refuse with state_unavailable?
options: Complete the placement and return M06 with status placed.
Return M08 with state_unavailable, change no record or stored image, and leave the placement incomplete.
open_points.default_guess: Apply A6 rule 5 and return M08 with state_unavailable without changing the orphaned image.

witness.initial: The stored image exists after a failed placement-record write, no placement exists, and the mark record exists but is damaged—a state contemplated by A3 rule 5 and A6 rule 5.
events: The calling agent repeats delivery of the same source file.
module:delivery_store reads the absent placement and the damaged mark while holding the project lock.
outcomes: The flow's Errors passage says the repeated delivery completes the placement.
The changed A3 rule 5 exception and A6 rule 5 say the operation is refused with state_unavailable and changes no record or stored image.
witness.observer: The calling agent sees placed M06 versus state_unavailable M08.
